_comment: Per-site reef market-gravity (Andrello et al. 2022 local-reef-pressures). gravity = raw market gravity (right-skewed); fishingPressureValue = global 0..1 percentile — band on the percentile. Built by scripts/fetch-reef-gravity.mjs. Sites with no mapped reef cell within maxPixelKm are omitted.
citation: Andrello et al. 2022, Conservation Letters, doi:10.1111/conl.12858
